note: Live-session recording (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Passwords are never in this file: the owner types the connection string once when prepare asks (Server=10.50.0.30,1433;Database=master;UID=<login>;<the login's password entry>;Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes); prepare keeps it in the MG_SQL_BASE variable of this session and derives SQL_CONNECTION_STRING for each database; teardown removes both. T-SQL set-up runs on CON-SQL01 over PowerShell Direct as the lab Administrator with Windows authentication (SQL Server's own sysadmin group is Domain Admins). Episode login: lab_demo, made sysadmin for this episode only. The rs_reader login's secret is typed by the owner when prepare asks. The report is published from CON-SRV02 over PowerShell Direct as the lab Administrator (the script uses the current Windows credentials, so the account must have rights on the report server).
prepare: $sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF SUSER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL THROW 50000, N'Create the login lab_demo first (episode 3 demo.md, setup step 3; owner types its password off camera).', 1;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 0 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin ADD MEMBER lab_demo;"

if (-not (Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { Get-Service SQLServerReportingServices -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue })) { throw 'Install SQL Server 2022 Reporting Services (Developer) on CON-SRV02 and create its report server database on CON-SQL01 first (owner, not recorded; see demo.md setup steps 1 and 2).' }
if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }
if (-not $env:RS_READER_PASSWORD) { Set-Item Env:RS_READER_PASSWORD (Read-Host 'rs_reader secret (strong, typed off camera, never saved)' -MaskInput) }

Invoke-Command -Session $s -ArgumentList $env:RS_READER_PASSWORD { param($p) Set-Item Env:RS_READER_PASSWORD $p; powershell.exe -NoProfile -File C:\lab\ep12\Deploy-Report.ps1 -ReportServer http://CON-SRV02/ReportServer -SqlServer CON-SQL01 -RdlPath C:\lab\ep12\report\SalesByProduct.rdl }

Select dataset SalesByProduct and open the Properties pane: Query Type = Stored Procedure

mask: server name or address 10.50.0.22 in the address bar
signed-in user name in the portal header

screens.name: ssrs-permissions
steps: Open SSMS 22 and connect to 10.50.0.30,1433 with SQL Server Authentication as lab_demo (secret typed off camera, Remember off); in Options > Connection Properties set the database to ContosoBikesRpt and tick Trust server certificate (lab only)
Grid, four rows: EXECUTE on Rpt.usp_SalesByProduct Allowed 1; EXECUTE on Rpt.usp_Regions Allowed 1; SELECT on Sales.Orders Allowed 0; SELECT on Sales.Customers Allowed 0
mask: server address 10.50.0.30 and the login name (Connect dialog, title bar, status bar, Object Explorer): connect through a hosts alias so it reads CON-SQL01, or blur
laptop machine name and Windows user name in title bars

teardown: if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }
if (-not $env:RS_READER_PASSWORD) { Set-Item Env:RS_READER_PASSWORD (Read-Host 'rs_reader secret (strong, typed off camera, never saved)' -MaskInput) }

Invoke-Command -Session $s { powershell.exe -NoProfile -File C:\lab\ep12\Deploy-Report.ps1 -ReportServer http://CON-SRV02/ReportServer -SqlServer CON-SQL01 -RdlPath C:\lab\ep12\report\SalesByProduct.rdl -Remove; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep12 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

$sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 1 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin DROP MEMBER lab_demo;"
